{
  "subtype": "exploratory_data_analysis",
  "focus_variable": "resolution_duration",
  "per_column": [
    {
      "name": "incident_category",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Clean, well-separated categorical (database/email/vpn/network/etc.) directly named in the query; ideal grouping axis for comparing resolution duration."
    },
    {
      "name": "affected_system",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Interpretable system-level categories with reasonable cell counts; a finer but still meaningful segmentation to compare durations across."
    },
    {
      "name": "incident_symptom_type",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Symptom taxonomy (connectivity_failure, access_denied, outage, performance_degradation) is interpretable and plausibly associated with how long resolution takes; some NULLs but usable."
    },
    {
      "name": "scope_indicator",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Individual vs system_wide vs location_specific is a well-separated, intuitive scope axis strongly plausibly related to resolution effort/duration."
    },
    {
      "name": "resolver_match",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Boolean (assignee matched resolver) is interpretable and can be segmented on; plausible operational driver of duration, though somewhat imbalanced (403/97)."
    },
    {
      "name": "opened_hour_bucket",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Business_hours/after_hours/overnight is a clean, interpretable temporal segmentation with balanced cells, a classic axis for exploring duration variation."
    },
    {
      "name": "is_repeat_issue",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Boolean repeat-issue flag is interpretable and groupable; recurrence plausibly relates to resolution duration."
    },
    {
      "name": "caller_type",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Named_employee vs itil_user is a clean binary segmentation that could reveal duration differences by caller class."
    }
  ],
  "n_predictors": 8,
  "relationship_informativeness": 0.85,
  "rationale": "All added columns are external, associational, and interpretable with well-separated, low-cardinality categories that can be grouped against resolution_duration. None merely restate the focus. incident_category directly echoes the existing 'category' field, and several flags are imbalanced (resolver_match, is_repeat_issue), slightly limiting comparative power, but as a set they open up multiple informative, human-readable segmentation axes (category, system, symptom, scope, timing, recurrence, caller type) well suited to exploratory analysis of duration."
}
